name: Per-feature stacked MICE/ET/KNN
tagline: Run MICE-BR, IterativeExtraTrees, and KNN imputers in parallel; per-feature softmax-weight them by cross-validated BayesianRidge MSE on observed values.
init_recovers: Average of MICE / ET / KNN when CV is unavailable
diff_from_baseline: Goes beyond MICE/MissForest/GAIN by running all three baselines and selecting per feature using cross-validated BayesianRidge errors with squared-inverse-MSE weights.

name: Adaptive iterative ensemble (BR+RF+KNN)
tagline: MissForest-style chained imputation where every column step is the inverse-MSE blend of BayesianRidge, RandomForest, and KNN regressors evaluated by 5-fold CV on observed data.
init_recovers: MissForest if RF dominates the inverse-MSE weighting
diff_from_baseline: Like MICE but each chained step is an inverse-MSE-weighted ensemble of BayesianRidge + RandomForest + KNN regressors, with per-feature CV evaluation every iteration.

name: Linear + ExtraTrees residual booster
tagline: Iterative imputation where each chained step fits BayesianRidge then an ExtraTreesRegressor on the linear residuals, with missingness mask augmentation and per-feature value clipping.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces single-estimator MICE with a per-feature BayesianRidge + ExtraTrees(residual) two-stage regressor, augmented with NaN mask features and value clipping each iteration.

name: Calibrated MICE+KNN with confidence gate
tagline: Iterative MICE limited to top-correlated predictors blended with distance-weighted KNN; per-feature blend weight calibrated by held-out pseudo-mask and modulated by R² confidence and neighbor closeness.
init_recovers: Pure MICE when w → 0; KNN when w → 1
diff_from_baseline: Adds calibration via pseudo-masking, top-correlation predictor pruning, R²-modulated KNN+BR blend, percentile clipping, and damped iterative updates on top of standard MICE.

name: KNN-init → MICE → variance calibration
tagline: Three-stage imputer: correlation-weighted KNN initialization, IterativeImputer with BayesianRidge refinement, then a per-feature mean/variance rescaling to the observed distribution.
init_recovers: Plain MICE if KNN init returns mean and calibration is skipped
diff_from_baseline: Adds a correlation-weighted KNN warm start before MICE and a variance-preserving per-feature mean/std calibration after iterative refinement.
